baseline_models.focus_anchor: The question joins seeing with what lies before and behind them from the sky and the earth, then calls the whole configuration a sign.
baseline_models.mechanism: Front and rear are filled out by the upper and lower bounds, turning ordinary location into a completely surrounding field of visible evidence rather than a remote spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Joins ocular perception and insight, making the opening question a demand to recognize what is already perceptible.
Supplies the interval occupied by what is immediately in front of the observers.
Makes the hands-construction denote the forward, approaching, or near field.
Adds the rearward field opposed to what is in front.
Provides the overhead canopy and source of the second threatened motion.
Provides the lower counterpart to the sky and the support that can become a sink.
Classifies this encompassing arrangement as an outwardly available mark.

changed_reading.before: They are asked to notice the sky and earth around them.
changed_reading.after: They occupy a front-to-back and above-to-below evidentiary enclosure; failure to see is failure of recognition amid an already visible sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional pairs causing the earth to sink with making a detached piece of sky fall upon them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two stable bounds can reverse their usual supporting and sheltering roles: the lower bound opens downward while material from the upper bound descends, closing both vertical exits under one act of will.

activation_trace.role: Makes the paired reversals contingent on will directed toward an object or event.
Supplies the ground's downward recession and swallowing motion.
Turns the ordinarily lower support into the medium of descent.
Supplies imposed downward fall from the opposite bound.
Makes what falls a separated portion rather than an undifferentiated sky.
Turns the overhead shelter into the source of descending matter.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists two alternative punishments.
changed_reading.after: The alternatives form one coordinated vertical trap: support below and shelter above are both reversible under divine will.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sign is specified for every servant described as munib.
baseline_models.mechanism: Servanthood supplies receptive obedience while inabah supplies repeated return; together they describe the posture that converts a surrounding fact into a personally legible sign.

activation_trace.role: Extends the stated availability of the sign to each member of the receptive class.
Supplies yielding obedience as the perceiver's relation to the sign-giver.
Supplies recurrent return as the motion by which attention is repeatedly reoriented.

changed_reading.before: Munib is a general commendatory adjective attached to the believer.
changed_reading.after: Returning servanthood is the verse's perceptual mechanism: repeated reorientation makes the enclosing world readable as a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first describes regular traffic into and out of earth and down from and up through sky. The focus threats invert that open circulation into one-way capture: entry becomes engulfment and descent becomes impact.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed model in the focus ayah's downward recession of ground.
Anchors the changed model in the focus ayah's imposed fall from above.
Supplies ordinary penetration into earth as one leg of the open system.
Supplies emergence to the exterior as the counterflow normally paired with entry.
Supplies normal downward arrival from the sky, whose direction the threat intensifies.
Supplies ascent as the open counter-direction that disappears in the threatened closure.

structural_cues: 34:2 arranges earth-entry/earth-exit and sky-descent/sky-ascent as two balanced pairs.
34:9 preserves the same earth-sky axis but gives each bound a destructive downward vector.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four normal directional flows and two threatened downward motions; I infer a reversal from circulation to capture. The live alternative is that 34:2 only inventories divine knowledge and does not define a physical system.

changed_reading.before: The earth-sinking and sky-fall are isolated catastrophic possibilities.
changed_reading.after: They are punitive reversals of the surah's normally open earth-sky circulation, converting exchange into inescapable one-way descent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, mockers equate total bodily tearing with the impossibility of new creation. The focus answers materially rather than abstractly: even the sky can be cut into portions and the earth can lose continuity, so apparent wholeness is not an independent limit on disassembly or renewed making.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in cutting a portion from a larger whole.
Makes the threatened object an actually separated piece of the encompassing sky.
Supplies the skeptics' image of a body torn and dispersed into pieces.
Places creative origination on the far side of the imagined disassembly.
Supplies new occurrence after a prior cutting, linking rupture to renewed creation.

structural_cues: 34:7 places total tearing and new creation in one skeptical sentence.
34:9 follows with earth discontinuity and a separated sky-piece.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mocked bodily partition, renewed creation, and divisible cosmic bounds; I infer that the focus threat undercuts the premise that integrity makes recreation impossible. Alternatively, the proximity may serve only as a change from resurrection polemic to punishment warning.

changed_reading.before: The falling sky-piece is only an image of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic partition also answers the preceding incredulity: if the containing world is divisible by will, bodily disassembly cannot set the measure of creative power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to the mountains to return with David gives return a responsive, repeated, and even environmental form. Munib can therefore be heard not only as private repentance but as participation in a world that answers a summons by turning back.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the perceiver in obedient service.
Anchors munib in recurrent return toward a point of orientation.
Supplies a commanded return shared by David's surrounding mountains, making response spatial and recurrent.

structural_cues: 34:10 addresses mountains and includes birds in the answering movement around David.
34:9 locates the returning servant inside a sky-earth surround.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct roots with convergent return images and an imperative addressed to creation; I infer responsive resonance between creation and the munib servant. The alternative is loose semantic echo without a functional link.

changed_reading.before: The returning servant is an inwardly repentant individual who notices a sign.
changed_reading.after: The returning servant is also a responsive participant: like the surrounding creation commanded to return, the servant repeatedly answers and thereby reads the surround.

context_deltas.mechanism: David's sequence makes hard metal soft, then submits linked construction to measure and ordered continuity. This supplies a local material grammar for the focus: hardness, support, continuity, and partition are directed properties, so earth can recess and sky can separate without being autonomous fixed limits.

activation_trace.role: Anchors changes of the cosmic media in a will directed toward an event.
Provides loss of continuity and level in the lower material bound.
Provides cutting or partition in the upper material bound.
Supplies the reversal of hardness into workable softness.
Supplies resistant iron as the material whose fixed-seeming property is changed.
Supplies deliberate measure governing how transformed material is arranged.
Supplies ordered continuity between linked parts, the inverse of the focus ayah's separation.

structural_cues: 34:10-11 moves from softening iron to measuring its linked construction.
34:9 moves from stable cosmic bounds to recession and detached pieces under will.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one explicit case of hardness made pliable and continuity deliberately measured; I extend that material logic to the focus ayah's earth and sky. The alternative is that David's craft is a bounded miracle with no implied cosmic material analogy.

changed_reading.before: Earth and sky are fixed scenery interrupted by miracles.
changed_reading.after: They are directed media whose level, hardness, continuity, and partition are no less contingent than the softened and measured material later in the surah.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solomon's apparently stable posture is secretly being undermined by an earth-creature consuming its support; the eventual fall makes hidden ignorance manifest. That sequence turns the focus's sinking and falling into disclosure-events: collapse does not merely destroy an arrangement but exposes the false knowledge that depended on its appearance of stability.

activation_trace.role: Anchors disclosure in the lower support receding beneath its occupants.
Anchors disclosure in an imposed fall from a previously stable position.
Makes the resulting event readable rather than merely destructive.
Activates the earth-root's wood-eating creature image as the hidden agent that removes a support.
Supplies incremental consumption of the staff on which the visible arrangement depends.
Supplies the noisy, destabilizing fall that ends the false appearance.
Makes the consequence of collapse an emergence into clarity: the jinn's limitation becomes manifest.

structural_cues: In 34:14 hidden erosion precedes a sudden fall, and the fall precedes recognition of ignorance.
In 34:9 both threatened motions terminate in an ayah, explicitly assigning evidentiary force to collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support-consumption, fall, and subsequent manifestation; I infer the arrow collapse -> disclosure and apply it to the focus threats. The live alternative is that 34:14's disclosure concerns only the jinn's unseen knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Sinking and falling visibly punish bodies.
changed_reading.after: They also break epistemic supports: a collapse can expose how much confidence rested on an unread, unstable surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Saba's dwelling, flanking gardens, visible towns, measured routes, and safe travel instantiate an inhabitable directional field. Flood, substitution, demanded distance, and scattering then reverse it. The focus surround is thus not only a threat-zone: its ordinary continuity is a maintained sign whose revocation converts nearness into distance and habitation into dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the occupied interval directly around the observer.
Anchors the accessible forward and near direction.
Completes the inhabited field with its rearward direction.
Allows the normal surround, not only catastrophe, to function as an outward sign.
Supplies settled habitation as the starting state of the spatial system.
Supplies one lateral flank of the inhabited field.
Supplies the opposite lateral flank, completing a directional enclosure around the settlement.
Supplies the flowing force that overturns the settled landscape.
Makes ecological reversal a change in the landscape's very form.
Supplies settlements visibly disclosed along the route.
Supplies continuous movement through the maintained corridor.
Supplies secure confidence as the lived effect of that spatial continuity.
Supplies the requested production of distance that negates accessible nearness.
Supplies final spatial dispersal into separated pieces.

structural_cues: 34:15 marks a dwelling with productive space on right and left.
34:18 measures a chain of visible settlements for safe movement by night and day.
34:16 and 34:19 reverse fertility, proximity, continuity, and social cohesion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a secure directional corridor and its historical reversal; I infer that the stable everyday surround in 34:9 is itself the sign before either threatened catastrophe occurs. Alternatively, the Saba sequence may be an independent historical exemplum rather than an expansion of the focus topology.

changed_reading.before: The sign consists chiefly in the possibility of extraordinary cosmic punishment.
changed_reading.after: The presently continuous, traversable surround is already a maintained sign; sinking, flood, distance, and scattering are coordinated ways that inhabitable continuity can be withdrawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the surah's close, seeing finally occurs amid panic, but escape has elapsed, seizure comes from a near place, attempted reaching comes from far away, and a barrier is installed between people and desire. This makes the focus question a temporal opening: see the surrounding sign and return while recognition can still alter direction.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the present demand for perceptive recognition.
Anchors the available response in recurrent return before closure.
Supplies a later scene in which sight coincides with panic rather than corrective insight.
Removes the possibility of getting beyond or reaching an escape.
Supplies capture that turns the threatened enclosure into an accomplished seizure.
Places that capture in the near field, answering the focus's immediately surrounding space.
Supplies an attempted reaching whose extension can no longer attain its object.
Locates belated reach at disabling distance from what is now desired.
Supplies an intervening barrier that converts surrounding space into separation.
Makes the interval between people and their object an imposed severance.
Names the desired object from which the late perceivers are cut off.

structural_cues: 34:9 opens with failed seeing and ends with the servant who repeatedly returns.
34:51-54 orders late sight, no escape, near capture, failed distant reach, and final interposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an early demand to see and a late scene of sight after agency has collapsed; I infer that 34:9 marks a preventable interval for reorientation. The alternative is that the two seeing scenes intensify warning without defining a temporal opportunity structure.

changed_reading.before: The opening rebuke asks for observation, and munib simply names the righteous audience.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is an actionable interval: perceptive return is possible now, whereas the surah's final sight arrives inside near capture and irreversible separation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the sky-root to a root of visible marking, so it is form-distant and must not replace the direct sense of sky. It remains anchored in the focus ayah's repeated sky and explicit ayah: the split branch lets the canopy itself act as a marked surface, and prose should label this a lexical activation rather than a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same sky that surrounds them can yield a cut-off piece, and the verse immediately names the configuration an ayah.

activation_trace.role: Activates a visible identifying mark within the packet's alternate mapping of the repeated sky-root.
Lets a portion be cut from the marked encompassing surface.
Confirms that the resulting configuration functions as an outward mark.

changed_reading.before: The sky is an overhead object that may shed a punitive fragment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the canopy is also a sign-bearing surface: a detached piece makes the surrounding world's markedness violently explicit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the packet's alternate mapping of the seeing-root to a massive rain-cloud branch and is therefore deliberately branch-distant. The sky-piece, falling motion, and later flood keep it physically anchored, but downstream prose should present atmospheric mass or cloudburst only as a possible image, never as the lexical replacement for kisf.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Seeing, sky, falling kisf, and the surah's destructive flood can be aligned as an atmospheric-discharge image.

activation_trace.role: Activates the form-distant image of a massive, hard-falling rain cloud at the act of seeing.
Keeps the activated mass located in the overhead canopy named by the focus ayah.
Anchors the image in a separated mass from the sky rather than free-floating weather imagery.
Supplies the surah's realized destructive torrent as a material analogue for atmospheric discharge.

changed_reading.before: Kisf is imagined only as a solid shard of the sky.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also evoke an oppressive sky-mass discharging as catastrophic weather, with Saba's torrent showing the earthward consequence.

strongest_changes: 34:2 turns the paired threats into a reversal of normal earth-sky circulation.
34:14 makes collapse evidentiary: hidden support failure exposes hidden ignorance.
34:15-19 makes ordinary habitable continuity itself a sign whose reversal yields distance and dispersal.
34:51-54 turns the opening demand to see into a time-sensitive opportunity for return before near capture and separation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly makes boundaries responsive rather than inert: matter softens and is measured, supports are consumed, settlements and routes are reconfigured, and late distance becomes a barrier. Against that pattern, munib also resonates with the commanded returning response of the mountains.
remaining_uncertainties: The relation between David's awb and the munib servant may be functional resonance rather than deliberate lexical linkage.
The directed-material model may overgeneralize from David's bounded craft to cosmic media.
The sky-mark and cloudburst readings rely on non-dominant mapped roots and must remain explicitly exploratory.
